subject: An invitation for Lynen to take over one web page
text:
Hi Chinedu,

I read Lynen’s explanation of comparing clothing-label claims with independently verified fabric content, and your founder story about checking whether a shirt really is cotton.

I built Take The Wall: one public page with one featured owner. Your project replaces the current content and stays until somebody else takes over.

Would you be interested in trying it with Lynen? Browsing and previewing are free; publishing a takeover costs $3.99. It’s an early experiment, with no guaranteed audience or duration.

Here’s the page: https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=personal&utm_medium=outreach&utm_campaign=first_owners&utm_content=lynen

No need to reply if it’s not your thing — I won’t send a follow-up sequence.

Take The Wall
contact@takethewall.com
